### Headline summary
- ConnectWise suspended cloud services to contain a supply chain attack where credentials were abused to target Microsoft 365 environments. ([Security Affairs](https://securityaffairs.com/201236/hacking/attackers-abuse-stolen-connectwise-application-credentials-to-target-microsoft-365.html), [Infosecurity Magazine](https://www.infosecurity-magazine.com/news/connectwise-shuts-off-cloud/))
- Hackers are actively exploiting Plex vulnerabilities in the wild to deploy cryptominer malware on affected systems. ([Cyber Security News (FeedBurner)](https://cybersecuritynews.com/plex-vulnerabilities-exploited-in-wild/), [SecurityWeek](https://www.securityweek.com/plex2shell-exploit-chain-weaponized-against-plex-servers-hours-after-disclosure/))
- A critical vulnerability in the SiteGuard WAF is being actively exploited by attackers to gain full control of servers. ([Security Affairs](https://securityaffairs.com/201258/security/japans-siteguard-waf-flaw-cve-2026-106931-is-already-being-exploited.html), [Cyber Security News (FeedBurner)](https://cybersecuritynews.com/hackers-exploit-siteguard-waf-vulnerability/))

### ConnectWise supply chain attack and credential abuse
ConnectWise suspended its cloud services to contain a supply chain attack, during which attackers abused ConnectWise credentials to target Microsoft 365 environments. ([Security Affairs](https://securityaffairs.com/201236/hacking/attackers-abuse-stolen-connectwise-application-credentials-to-target-microsoft-365.html), [Infosecurity Magazine](https://www.infosecurity-magazine.com/news/connectwise-shuts-off-cloud/), [CSO Online](https://www.csoonline.com/article/4237087/connectwise-backup-credentials-exposed-multiple-microsoft-365-tenants.html), [SecurityWeek](https://www.securityweek.com/connectwise-suspends-cloud-services-in-response-to-cyberattack/))

### Plex vulnerabilities exploited to deploy cryptominers
Hackers are actively exploiting Plex vulnerabilities in the wild, specifically the Plex2Shell flaws, to install cryptominer malware on affected systems. ([Cyber Security News (FeedBurner)](https://cybersecuritynews.com/plex-vulnerabilities-exploited-in-wild/), [SecurityWeek](https://www.securityweek.com/plex2shell-exploit-chain-weaponized-against-plex-servers-hours-after-disclosure/), [The Hacker News](https://thehackernews.com/2026/10/hackers-exploit-plex2shell-flaws-to.html), [Security Affairs](https://securityaffairs.com/201324/hacking/plex2shell-exploit-used-to-turn-vulnerable-plex-servers-into-crypto-miners.html))

### SiteGuard WAF vulnerability exploited in the wild
A critical vulnerability in the SiteGuard WAF (CVE-2026-106931) is being actively exploited by hackers to gain full control of servers. ([Security Affairs](https://securityaffairs.com/201258/security/japans-siteguard-waf-flaw-cve-2026-106931-is-already-being-exploited.html), [Cyber Security News (FeedBurner)](https://cybersecuritynews.com/hackers-exploit-siteguard-waf-vulnerability/))

### Critical Drupal RCE vulnerability enables unauthenticated takeover
Drupal released security updates for a critical remote code execution vulnerability in the Entity List and Field UI modules that allows attackers to take over websites without authentication. ([SecurityWeek](https://www.securityweek.com/drupal-warns-of-fast-exploitation-risk-for-critical-core-rce-flaw/), [Cyber Security News (FeedBurner)](https://cybersecuritynews.com/drupal-rce-vulnerability/))

### Rank Math PRO WordPress plugin compromised in supply chain attack
Hackers injected malware into Rank Math PRO version 3.0.123 packages distributed between October 15 and 17, delivering a self-restoring backdoor to users. ([SecurityWeek](https://www.securityweek.com/rank-math-pro-wordpress-plugin-compromised-in-supply-chain-attack/), [The Hacker News](https://thehackernews.com/2026/10/popular-wordpress-seo-plugin-rank-math.html))

### AOMEI Backupper update servers compromised to spread malware
Attackers compromised AOMEI Technology's update servers to distribute malware through the software's promotional update mechanism, prompting warnings for users to check their systems. ([Malwarebytes Labs (Vendor)](https://www.malwarebytes.com/blog/news/2026/10/aomei-backupper-update-servers-hijacked-to-push-malware-check-your-pc), [BleepingComputer](https://www.bleepingcomputer.com/news/security/hackers-hijack-aomei-update-servers-to-secretly-spread-malware/))

### Bullhorn disables platform to contain cyberattack
Staffing software company Bullhorn has disabled access to its platform to contain an ongoing cyberattack. ([/r/cybersecurity](https://www.reddit.com/r/cybersecurity/comments/1x9lk21/bullhorn_cyber_incident_developing_now/), [BleepingComputer](https://www.bleepingcomputer.com/news/security/bullhorn-takes-staffing-platform-offline-to-contain-cyberattack/))

### California student data stolen via compromised ETS credentials
Intruders used compromised credentials to access an ETS SFTP server, stealing personal information belonging to millions of current and former California public school students. ([Malwarebytes Labs (Vendor)](https://www.malwarebytes.com/blog/data-breaches/2026/10/millions-of-california-students-sensitive-data-stolen-in-breach), [SecurityWeek](https://www.securityweek.com/one-compromised-login-exposed-millions-of-california-students-records/))
